title: Generalized Harmonic Measures: Synchronized Approximation, Representation and Quantitative Measure Recovery
summary: We study synchronized boundary and kernel approximation for harmonic measure systems satisfying nested mean-value identities. Under boundary concentration along a common subsequence, joint limits yield representation on a common refinement, and gluing gives uniqueness on the minimal boundary. Neighborhood nonvanishing gives full-sequence synchronized selection.
